title: D2P Avatar Profile
description: Versioned vocabulary describing how body models (avatars) are derived from body measurements (design decision ADR-029 §3, §4): pose, required body definitions, linear derivations of optional definitions, the tolerance of each control measure, landmarks and the landmark-defined body zones of fit maps. A profile is pinned before any comparison run and never adjusted afterwards; a frozen profile is immutable. Files are stored as vocabularies/avatar-profiles/<local>-<version>.json for profileId d2p:<local>.
$comment: Schema catalog section 3.9 (draft 0.3.0). Not schema-enforced: definitions resolve via definitionRegistries and are body lengths (D2P-REF-008, D2P-SEM-075, D2P-SEM-070); derivations name non-required definitions and use required ones only, tolerances cover exactly the required and derived definitions, zones name declared landmarks (D2P-SEM-127); sorted arrays (D2P-REF-014).

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

profileId.description: Qualified name of the profile; with version it identifies the profile.

version.description: Version of the profile, independent of the standard version.

status.description: provisional: proposed values, not to be used for comparing implementations; frozen: adopted and immutable (a changed value is a new version).

pose.description: Pose of body models derived with this profile.

definitionRegistries.description: Measurement-definition registries against which every definitionId of this profile resolves (D2P-REF-008).

requiredDefinitions.description: Body definitions a body source MUST provide as its own values (values a body measurement profile copied from its baseline count; the baseline size entry itself is not read). Without one of them no body model is derived (D2P-SEM-127, AVA-003). Sorted, unique.

derivations.description: Versioned rules for body definitions that the body source may leave out: such a value is derived linearly from required definitions and marked 'inferred' (design decision ADR-029 §4 rule 3). Sorted by definitionId. Omitted when the profile derives nothing.

tolerances.description: Permitted deviation of each control measure taken on the body model from its target: exactly one entry per required or derived definition, sorted by definitionId (D2P-SEM-127). A body model outside a tolerance is a finding, not a valid result (AVA-001).

landmarks.description: Landmarks every body model of this profile places, sorted by landmarkId.

zones.description: Body zones of fit maps, each defined by landmarks of this profile (FMP-001). Sorted by zone.

toleranceProfile.description: Tolerance profile body models of this profile are compared with across implementations.

notes.description: Free-text notes on provenance and status of the values.

avatarDerivation.title: Avatar derivation
avatarDerivation.description: Linear rule for one body definition: value (mm) = interceptMm + Σ coefficient × value of a required definition. A derivation never uses another derived definition.

definitionId.description: Derived body definition; not a required definition.

terms.description: Terms; each names a required definition of the profile.

derivationTerm.title: Derivation term
derivationTerm.description: One linear term of a derivation.

definitionId.description: A required definition of the profile.

avatarTolerance.title: Avatar tolerance
avatarTolerance.description: Permitted absolute deviation of one control measure.

avatarLandmark.title: Avatar landmark
avatarLandmark.description: A named point every body model of the profile places.

avatarZone.title: Avatar zone
avatarZone.description: A body zone of fit maps and the landmarks that delimit it.

landmarkIds.description: Landmarks of this profile that delimit the zone (sorted, unique).
